column1: # Application policies (taskiem_app, or PUBLIC) on tables with a tenant_id
# column that do not scope rows to the caller's tenants (threat model B7).
# TestEveryTenantTableIsProtected fails when such a policy is not listed
# here, or a listed one is scoped or gone: a wide policy needs a line in
# its own change, with an owner who reviewed it and a one-line reason (what
# a tenant can see or write through it, and why that is intended).

column3: A person's own copy of their conversations with businesses (taskiem-for-everyone §14): scoped to the person (taskiem_person_scope()), and, once a door names one business, to that business's rows only; or, once a business reached them (taskiem_person_reached()), that one person's rows with that business; tenant_id names the business, not an owner (00452, 00456)
A person's own copy of their messages with businesses: scoped to the person, and to one business once a door names it; or one person's with the business that reached them (00452, 00456)

A person's own copy of photos, voice notes and files in their conversations with businesses: scoped to the person, and to one business once a door names it; or one person's with the business that reached them (00452, 00456)
A person reports a conversation to Taskiem's moderators: insert only, as the person in scope; no tenant reads reports (00452)
A person's own devices for pushes on You (taskiem-for-everyone §9): no business (tenant_id NULL), scoped to the person (taskiem_person_scope()); a tenant never sees or writes them (00460)
A person's own queued pushes (a business message in their chat on You): no business, scoped to the person in scope only (00460)

A person's own saved things (saved objects S0): rows with no business (tenant_id NULL, person_id set), scoped to the person in scope (taskiem_person_scope()) and never once a door names a business; a tenant never sees or writes them. The business's own rows are under tenant_isolation (00491)

A person's own made-up kinds (saved objects S1): rows with no business, scoped to the person in scope (taskiem_person_scope()) and never once a door names a business; a tenant never sees or writes them. The business's kinds are under tenant_isolation (00493)

A person's own saved files (saved objects S1), sealed under their key: rows with no business, scoped to the person in scope (taskiem_person_scope()) and never once a door names a business; a tenant never sees or writes them. The business's files are under tenant_isolation (00495)

A person's own reminders on their own saved things' dates (saved objects S2): rows with no business, scoped to the person in scope (taskiem_person_scope()) and never once a door names a business; a tenant never sees or writes them. The business's reminders are under tenant_isolation (00510)
